title: Water Fix
description: Plugin that make water not to destroy redstone things and does not affect any concrete.
body:
# Water fix

Plugin that makes water to not affect any concrete and break redstone things

## Who needs it?

Builders, redstone geniuses, e.t.c.

## Commands:
- /waterfix on/off - turn on/off the plugin

### List of items which includes:
- Any concrete powder
- Lever
- Reapeter
- Comporator
- Stone, oak buttons
- redstone dust
- Tripewire hook
- Tripewire
- Torch
- Redstone torch


[GitHub](https://github.com/kilkaVhlebe/Water-Fix)
